prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single production-quality 3D character costume concept for the hands and forearms in StoryOS, a magical private study. This is a visual design proposal for later Blender modeling, not a new animation and not a UI mockup.
Input images: image 1 is the EXISTING first-person book-opening composition and pose to preserve; image 2 is the APPROVED room mood, material style and restrained fantasy aesthetic, not a request to redesign the room.
Target dimensions: 1512 x 751, landscape approximately 2:1, matching image 1. Produce one independent concept only, no collage, no insets.
Framing invariants: preserve image 1's first-person downward camera, the green leather book and tilted wooden lectern, lifted nearly vertical green cover on the left, open cream page block, left hand steadying the lower book edge, right hand lifting the cover, right forearm entering diagonally from lower right, left forearm entering from lower left, and the fireplace beyond to the right. Keep the same book scale, crop, room geometry and light direction. Remove all browser/debug UI, controls, text, and watermark-like overlays. Show both wrists and generous visible sleeve length. Do not add a face, full character, floating detached hands or additional props.
Human design: anatomically credible adult human hands with five digits per hand, healthy natural warm-neutral skin, elegant elongated impression but normal finger lengths, modestly narrower palms than the source, softly defined knuckles, natural short nails, and enough flesh around thumb bases and forearms. Balanced proportions, neither skinny nor bulky. Wrist gently narrows into the hand and forearm gradually gains volume, never a rigid straight cone. Preserve plausible cover contact. Retain the pose; this exploration is about modeling, clothing and materials.
Rendering: polished, gently stylized real-time 3D game concept, same soft simplified realism as the approved room; believable anatomy and fabric structure, restrained texture detail, readable silhouettes. Warm amber hearth key light and soft cool ambient fill. Expose cuff material clearly without bleaching skin. No photoreal skin pores, giant veins, claws, waxy skin, gym muscles, flat plastic fabric, armor, huge bell sleeves, dangling chains, luminous magic effects or ornate clutter.

Additional image 3 is a companion concept: preserve its same hands, visible wrist length, pose, skin tone, camera composition and lighting for fair comparison; create the DISTINCT costume below, not the companion outfit.
Direction name: Woodland Arcanist.
Design: a cultivated woodland wizard reading at home in this same hearth study, never a ranger or warrior. Muted moss-grey green soft fine linen-wool blend sleeves, warm flax/cream fitted undercuffs. Natural, slightly relaxed cloth drape with one subtly curved gusset seam and just two broad soft folds; wrist remains gracefully tapered and forearm has healthy proportion. A short softly folded outer cuff is secured on its OUTER/BACK side by one small warm brown suede button-tab and a single aged brass button, clearly sewn into the cloth. This is a tiny soft closure, not a wrapped leather bracer, belt, buckled armor, or wrist restraint. A narrow, tone-on-tone botanical/fern stitch follows the cuff edge; subdued flax stitching along the sleeve's curved seam. Real fabric edge thickness and understated tactile weave. Fresh enough to be beautiful and cared for, gently used, not ragged. Palette is a visible muted moss green under warm hearth light, with warm taupe-brown and cream accents. Cloth construction looks comfortable and personal. No rings, gloves, metal bands, rigid straps, glowing runes, fur, leaves attached to clothing or extra props. Keep anatomical hands and book contact in the shared pose. No text or labels.
